text:
Elaine: Quick sync — we need final copy for the activation funnel landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) before the webinar on Apr 12. Main asks: launch post, short benchmark narrative (latency/cost wins), webinar blurb, and inbound lead routing. Who can take what? :rocket:
Mike: I can draft the benchmark narrative. Will focus on 99th pct latency and cost/unit comparisons vs clouds. Need numbers from infra (ETA tomorrow).
Olivia: I’ll take the launch post + webinar blurb. Want microcopy for hero + 2 CTAs (Get started / Request demo).
Samir: I’ll own inbound routing and lead tags. Plan is to split leads by deployment interest: hosted -> growth SDRs, dedicated -> sales AE pool, private -> enterprise team. Will add UTMs + contact form routing rules.
Jess: I can mock up copy treatments for each mode — three headline variants per page and microcopy under the hero. Also propose a reduced-words variant for mobile.
Mike: For the benchmark narrative, thinking structure: 1) one-line claim, 2) one compact chart callout, 3) short methodology note + link to full benchmark. Keep it <120 words for the landing.
Olivia: Draft headline options (first pass):
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features fast — hosted API with predictable latency"
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, reserved GPU pools"
- Private: "Private inference in your VPC or on-prem"
Thoughts? Too wordy?
Jess: I like the direction. For Hosted swap to "Launch faster with a low-latency hosted API" (more benefit-led). For Private add a short security tag: "Private inference — VPC, KMS, audit logs".
Samir: Routing rules (proto):
```
if interest == "hosted": route = "growth-sdr@redwood.com"; tag = "route:hosted"
elif interest == "dedicated": route = "ae-dedicated@redwood.com"; tag = "route:dedicated"
elif interest == "private": route = "enterprise@redwood.com"; tag = "route:private"
```
Also add utm_campaign=webinar_apr12, utm_source=landing.
Olivia: For CTAs: primary = "Start free" (hosted), "Request capacity" (dedicated), "Talk to sales" (private). Secondary = "Read benchmark" across all pages.
Mike: For the benchmark callout on the page copy: short stat examples: "30% lower per-token cost at 95th throughput" / "sub-20ms median on nvlink clusters" — placeholders until infra confirms. Keep them bold/short.
Jess: Microcopy under hero (examples): "Same API across hosted, dedicated, and private — ship once, run anywhere." and a one-liner: "Pin model versions, predictable latency, and cost controls for production workloads."
Samir: For lead routing we should include a hidden field on the form: deployment_interest and expected_monthly_tokens. That will help prioritization.
Olivia: I'll draft the launch post and webinar blurb by EOD Friday. Mike, can you share benchmark bullet points by Thursday so I can fold them into the hero + secondary content?
Mike: Yep, will push numbers Thursday morning.
Jess: I'll post mobile-friendly copy variants and PNG comps in Figma by Friday as well.
CopyBot: Auto-summary: copy owners assigned — Mike (benchmark), Olivia (launch post + webinar blurb), Samir (routing & tags), Jess (hero treatments). Freeze target: 2027-04-05.
Elaine: Perfect. Quick checklist: 1) copy freeze 4/5, 2) routing rules live + QA by 4/8, 3) publish + webinar on 4/12. If anyone slips, call it out here. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
Samir: Noted — I’ll create the routing PR and include QA steps (test leads per bucket).
Olivia: Will post drafts as separate threads per page so we can iterate quickly.
Jess: Will sync on spacing — may need slightly reworded CTAs to fit buttons.
Elaine: Thanks all — feel free to @ here when drafts up.
